settingsBody: Bookings go into your Google Calendar, and your busy times there block booking slots.
title: Google Calendar
lead: Keep bookings and your private life in one calendar.
loadError: This didn't load. Check your connection and try again.

off.title: Calendar sync isn't set up yet
off.body: The server has no Google keys yet. Bookings work as usual; ask the owner to set up calendar sync.

noCalendar.title: You have no calendar yet
noCalendar.body: Only coaches with a calendar can connect Google Calendar. Ask the owner to add yours.

intro.title: Connect Google Calendar
intro.body: Every confirmed booking appears in your calendar, and moves or disappears when it is moved or cancelled. Busy times in your calendar block those times for booking, within 5 minutes.
intro.privacy: The event shows the customer's first name and the service only: never their email, phone or health answers.

connected.title: Connected
connected.calendarHint: Your busy times are read from this calendar and your main one.
connected.calendarsError: Your calendars didn't load. Try again later.
connected.disconnectNote: Disconnecting deletes our access. Events already in your calendar stay there.

reconnect.title: Connect your calendar again
reconnect.body: Google no longer lets us reach your calendar, so bookings aren't synced right now. Booking still works; connect again to catch up.

result.denied: You didn't allow access, so nothing was connected.
result.scope: Allow both calendar permissions on Google's screen, or sync can't work.

errors.calendar_off: Calendar sync isn't set up on the server.
errors.google_unavailable: Google Calendar didn't answer. Try again in a minute.
